**http://maker:4001**

1. Save an obscure link again: paste `https://example.org/reports/2026/q1-summary` and press **Save**. It comes in with a rough auto-name ("Q1 Summary") and no description.
2. Click **"Edit tags & note"** on it. You'll now see **Title** and **Description** fields at the top of the editor (the title is focused and selected, ready to overwrite).
3. Give it a proper title like `Q1 2026 Summary Report` and a description, optionally add a tag, then press **Save**. The card updates to your text.
4. Search for a word from the title or description you just wrote, and confirm the link surfaces — so your own wording makes it findable later.

A couple of notes on what I decided — tell me if they suit you:

- **Everything lives in one editor now:** title, description, tags, and note are edited together in the same inline panel, saved with one **Save**.
- **A title is always kept:** if you clear the title box entirely and save, I fall back to the link's web address as its name rather than leaving it blank — so a link is never nameless.
